notes.title: Patch 1 Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]What's new?[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Deposit Animation
[*] Cursor locks to window for the multi-monitored and windowed among us
[*] Controls screen input type headers
[*] Controls screen reset icons
[*] Tooltips are now much more useful
[/list]

[h1]What's fixed?[/h1]
[list]
[*] Celebration volume is now impacted by the volume settings (thanks ANNOYING CROW, caw caw)
[*] Other audios are boosted more appropriately
[*] Miscellaneous jank
[/list]
